name: fx_forest_holdleft
doc: Stands in for saves/battle_re/forest_holdleft_pre.state, the root of the suite's Guardia Forest fights: in Guardia Forest (loc 013) Crono walks north-west as battle_forest_3hetake does, up to the lane left of which the second group of 'mushroom' bushes hides the three Hetakes, then a step right and back left so that Marle closes up behind him in line: Crono stands at (0970, 267F) facing left with Marle at (0A60, 267F), the capture's positions. Holding Left from here walks into the ambush (the staging C0/0430 at f171, the battle's boot at f223).
